narrative_passages.title: Ibrahim and the star, moon and sun

summary_for_children: Al-An'am shows the signs of Allah in the sky and the earth. It tells how Ibrahim looked at a star, the moon and the sun and saw that they all set.
environment_concept: A night of signs turning to dawn: a ridge where a bright star sets (6:76), a plain where the moon rises (6:77), an overlook at sunrise (6:78), a valley where seeds split and sprout (6:95) and date palms with low clusters (6:99).
architecture_and_scenery: Wide desert plain, rocky ridge for watching the sky, a green valley with date palms and grain.

palette.atmosphere: Clear cold night warming to dawn

areas.name: Ridge of the Star
areas.description: A ridge to watch a bright star set.

areas.name: Moon Rise Plain
areas.description: The moon rises and then sets.

areas.name: Sunrise Overlook
areas.description: The sun rises; the narrator reads 6:79.

areas.name: Valley of Seeds
areas.description: Seeds split and sprout in a green valley.

activities.name: What sets and what stays
activities.description: Watch star, moon and sun each set, and reflect, as the ayahs say, on turning to the Creator.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Split the seed
activities.description: Plant three seeds and watch each split and sprout.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator follows the ayahs closely for Ibrahim's reasoning, without showing him, and labels any explanation.
learning_objectives: Explain why things that set are not worthy of worship
Name signs of Allah in plants
required_assets: Desert night sky with sun and moon cycle

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (constellation, disc, grain, horizon, mountain, palms) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

adventure_world.title: The Living World of Creation
adventure_world.source: "Quran Adventure: First 10 Unique Worlds" with the rule "114 unique game experiences" (2026-11-04); replaces the first adventure version built from the earlier design table
adventure_world.status: second version built for the web: each world now has its own core mechanic; draft, unreviewed; checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL only, not on phones or real GPUs
adventure_world.note: The new-look adventure world for this surah. It is a separate design from the composed scene this record describes; both are kept until reviewers choose.
adventure_world.core_play: A nature-discovery world: turn the sky from night to day at the hilltop dial, then fill a field journal by watching animals and plants quietly. You never move or round up the animals.
